title: All Shall be Torches
description: All your items are now... TORCHES!
body:
# TORCHES EVERYWHERE!

This resource pack replaces every single texture of an item in Minecraft with a torch version: stick on bottom, part of original texture on top.

This was made for giggles only. Youtube Video soon!

!["Ingredients" Tab with torches, with A. Debris crossed out](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b7fcefcfe853bc2946a22175804d3f20d7dab0c0.png)

Goals:
- Get blocks working
- Fix potions and tipped arrows
Known Bugs:
- Eating Particles on food shows missing texture

Please report anything wrong with a texture or ideas to me on the [linked PMC page](https://www.planetminecraft.com/texture-pack/all-shall-be-torches/) or in the description of a related YT video (also coming soon).
